hero.headline: Sisora: A Dedicated Brokerage for .SI Domains
hero.subheadline: Sisora is a dedicated brokerage connecting .si domain investors to buy and sell domain names. We manage negotiations between buyers and sellers, helping turn opportunities into completed transactions.

brokerageTerms.commissionDetail: Our standard brokerage commission is 15% of the final sale price, payable according to the agreed brokerage terms.
brokerageTerms.exclusivityDetail: Each accepted domain is subject to a 90-day exclusive brokerage agreement. During this period, the owner agrees not to independently sell, advertise, promote, or appoint another broker to market the domain, as specified in the signed agreement.
brokerageTerms.negotiationsDetail: We manage negotiations between buyers and sellers within the authority granted to us.
brokerageTerms.coordinationDetail: We help coordinate payment and domain transfer through Escrow.com or Atom.com, as appropriate and subject to the selected platform's requirements.
brokerageTerms.footnote: The specific commission obligations, exclusivity period, and transaction terms will be documented in the applicable brokerage agreement.

founder.name: Domingo
founder.title: Founder, Sisora
founder.bio: He is one of the most active guys in the domain industry, having closed several LLL.com deals and worked with some of the world’s top domain investors on LLL.coms, CVCV.com, One word .coms, LLL.ai, One word .ai names and many more, among many others. Recently, he has also been involved in deals involving .si domains like LM.si, Need.si, and more.
founder.footnote: These represent Domingo’s previous brokerage transactions. More deals will be added as Sisora grows.
